skill.name: reverse-any-video
skill.description: Rebuild any video file as an editable HyperFrames project - motion graphics, talking heads, live action or AI-generated footage. Measure and watch it, rebuild every layer, then check the render against the original frame by frame. Use to reverse, recreate, replicate or copy a video.
skill.summary: Rebuild source videos as editable HyperFrames projects using measured timing, layered graphics, generated footage, and render comparisons.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: The 17 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, legitimate media commands, account status checks, and supervised rendering. Separate risks involve paid generation without confirmation, suppressed cost disclosure, and cloud processing without explicit approval. No evidence found of credential theft, destructive commands, or audit-directed prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Paid generation starts without confirmation, while cost and credit information is deliberately withheld.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose estimated charges, obtain an explicit budget, and enforce credit limits before generation and retries. Include actual usage in the completion report.

remediation.issue: The workflow defaults to HeyGen generation and cloud rendering without an explicit approval step for source media processing.
remediation.suggestion: Explain which media leaves the device and which services receive it. Obtain approval before transfer and offer a local workflow for sensitive footage.

content.user_title: Rebuild Videos as Editable HyperFrames Projects
content.value_statement: Finished videos are difficult to revise when their source projects are unavailable. This skill guides reconstruction into editable HyperFrames layers with measured timing and visual comparisons.
actual_capabilities: Measure source dimensions, fractional frame rates, duration, cuts, and regions of consecutive frames.
Rebuild text, captions, graphics, and interface elements as editable HTML layers.
Extract embedded assets and preserve the original soundtrack while muting individual clips.
Guide HeyGen shot generation using source frames, motion guides, masks, and original audio.
Compare reconstructed frames and final renders against the source, then document remaining approximations.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames Pro, authentication, compatible media tools, and the surrounding HyperFrames project conventions.
HeyGen generation and cloud rendering use external services; generation can consume paid credits.
Exact matches are not guaranteed because fonts, generated people, grain, and other details can differ.
Users must have rights to reuse the source and approve external processing of sensitive media.

use_cases.title: Recover an Editable Motion Design
use_cases.description: Reconstruct titles, transitions, and graphic layers from an authorized final render when the original project is unavailable.

use_cases.title: Rebuild a Talking-Head Edit
use_cases.description: Recreate shot boundaries and captions while preserving the soundtrack, with explicit approval for any generated person footage.

use_cases.title: Compare a Recreated Campaign Video
use_cases.description: Review timing, missing elements, audio offsets, and visual differences before approving an editable reconstruction.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Reconstruction
prompt_templates.prompt: Rebuild [video] as an editable HyperFrames project. Check prerequisites and ask before paid generation or external processing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: reconstruct an authorized source video.

prompt_templates.title: Match Graphics and Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconstruct [video] with editable titles and captions. Measure exact switch frames, preserve source dimensions and audio, and identify substituted fonts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: recover layered graphics with precise timing.

prompt_templates.title: Control Generated Footage
prompt_templates.prompt: Rebuild [video] with HeyGen shots only after I approve the media transfer and cost plan. Enforce a maximum of [credits] credits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: constrain externally generated person footage.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Validate a Reconstruction
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [project] against [video]. Recheck authentication and approval limits, rebuild saved commands safely, compare cuts and audio, and report remaining differences.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: continue an existing project and verify its final render.

output_examples.input: Rebuild an authorized motion graphic with editable captions and titles.
output: Reconstruction summary: titles and captions are editable layers, and the original soundtrack is preserved.
Timing review: cuts and caption switches follow measured source frames.
Remaining approximation: a substitute font differs from the source letter shapes.

output_examples.input: Review a reconstructed talking-head video against its source.
output: Comparison summary: shot boundaries, duration, and audio alignment were checked against the source.
Remaining differences: generated facial details and motion blur do not match exactly.
Delivery summary: the editable project includes a reconstruction note identifying extracted assets, generated shots, and approximations.

best_practices: Use footage you have permission to reuse, and approve external processing before source media leaves your device.
Set and enforce a generation budget before starting, including retries and resumed work.
Measure frame timing and compare renders against the source before accepting the reconstruction.
anti_patterns: Treating video reconstruction as simple reverse playback or expecting guaranteed pixel-identical output.
Starting paid generation without a confirmed budget or processing confidential footage without approval.
Reusing saved commands without rebuilding their arguments and checking the execution plan.

faq.question: Does this skill play a video backward?
faq.answer: No. It reconstructs the video as an editable HyperFrames project rather than reversing playback.

faq.question: Which tools and account are required?
faq.answer: The workflow requires HyperFrames Pro and compatible media tooling. It uses HyperFrames commands and can also involve ffmpeg, Python, and HeyGen.

faq.question: Will the reconstructed video match exactly?
faq.answer: Exact matching is not guaranteed. Generated people, substitute fonts, grain, and other visual details can differ despite measured timing and comparisons.

faq.question: Can the workflow consume paid credits?
faq.answer: Yes. HeyGen generation can consume credits. Require a cost plan and explicit budget before generation or retries.

faq.question: Does source media stay on my computer?
faq.answer: Not by default. The workflow uses HeyGen and cloud rendering. Require approval before external processing, or request a restricted local workflow.

faq.question: What happens to the original audio?
faq.answer: The original video supplies the continuous soundtrack, while individual clips remain muted. The workflow instructs against cloning voices.
